## Result

Your system is using `SDDM` as the login manager.

### What to change
Edit `/etc/sddm.conf` and in the `[General]` section change:

```ini
Numlock=off
```

to:

```ini
Numlock=on
```

### Command
Run as root:

```bash
sudo cp /etc/sddm.conf /etc/sddm.conf.bak
sudo sed -i 's/^Numlock=off/Numlock=on/' /etc/sddm.conf
```

> After that, SDDM will enable NumLock by default on the login screen.
